playtest.title: Playtest feedback
playtest.note: Screenshots from playing the build, with what needs to change.

images.credit: Marc Simonetti (found on Pinterest) — copyrighted; mood reference only
takeaways: Looking down into a sunlit plaza walled in by towering, over-carved architecture
One hot amber key light with deep brown shadow; almost monochrome warm palette
Stairs, balconies and arches stacked vertically; crowd pouring in from a side street

images.credit: Photo of a Jaisalmer haveli lane (Pinterest)
takeaways: Golden sandstone, every surface carved: jharokhas, jali screens, brackets, awnings
Lane life at street level: women on a plinth, a shrine niche, a cow, goods stacked by doors
Narrow vertical slot of light; buildings overhang the lane

images.credit: Photo of a diya prayer gathering (Pinterest)
takeaways: Hundreds seated in rows on the ground, each with small oil lamps in front
Thick smoke under a great tree turns the whole space into glowing orange haze
Light comes from below and from the crowd itself, not from the sky
Ghats run along the river for as far as the eye sees; temples and towers on top
Steps crowded with people; long shadows across the steps from a low sun
Boats moored and drifting, floating diyas, glittering water and haze
A row of priests on raised platforms lifting tiered brass lamps in unison
Maroon and gold dhotis/shawls; smoke lit from inside by the flames
Small diyas lining the platform edges; dark night background
Roofs read as one repeated tile: flat slabs ringed by identical orange merlons
Walls rising above neighbouring roofs are blank — they need windows, jalis, jharokhas
Roofscape needs layers: rooftop rooms, varied parapets, clutter, less orange trim
Plane cut leaves jharokhas, hoods, frames and awnings floating half-dithered
Cut a blocking building as one object (everything above its stub height), never per-pixel slices
Keep everything behind the player: split big landmarks into pieces instead
Per-pixel plane cut leaves a thin dithered slice through a house and floating window frames
Same fix as 07: cut whole buildings (above their own stub height) as one object
Long diagonal shadow streaks on the palace face with no visible caster: cut pieces were still casting shadows
Cut state flickers as the player walks under the bridge — needs a hold before restoring
A big haveli seen whole from the lane — the reference for what should stay when walking behind it
Whole-building cut is too blunt for big buildings: walking behind one made all of it vanish
Cut only the part that blocks the view (per 2 m cell), keep the rest
The building the player stands in front of (beyond them) got cut, exposing a dark interior wall
Sight lines must only start from open ground around the player, never from inside a building
